parts.name: Library client apps
parts.description: dashboards and registration screen that users see and use

parts.name: Registration endpoint
parts.description: exposes POST /api/auth/register and receives registration parameters

parts.name: Registration error mapper
parts.description: maps invalid, existing-user and security errors to HTTP 400 or 401

parts.name: Library facade
parts.description: forwards registration requests to the user manager

parts.name: User registration validator
parts.description: validates role data, checks uniqueness, creates and registers the user

parts.name: Library domain model
parts.description: holds users, students, librarians and reservations

parts.name: User registry storage
parts.description: looks up users for uniqueness checks and saves new users

parts.name: Persistence storage
parts.description: persists entities in JPA transactions with rollback and queries by field
